review.note: Retracted in M21: the plebiscitary election of 28 April 1918 that ratified Sidónio Pais’s regime, boycotted by the Democrats, the Evolutionists and the Republican Union, who between them had won over 90% of the seats in 1915. Genuinely notable, and it sits between two events the atlas already holds — the coup of December 1917 and the assassination of December 1918. But every edge out of it would be this assistant’s construction rather than an argument found in the bibliography.
